section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1967
title: 4 in Table 4. The maximum volume of crime has been noticed in the State of Maharashtra (45·4) and minimum in Punjab (10·2) among the major States. The same pattern was observed during 1966 also. The incidence of accidental deaths in Union Territories is of the order of only 2·3% of all-India total. The volume of accidental deaths in the cities under study is on an average significantly higher than the all-India volume viz. 38·0 as against 24·8 of India. Among these Bombay recorded the maximum (64.4) volume of accidental deaths. TABLE—4
